answer.rationale: Regional failover (memory_b2) previously restored latency fast with clean traffic shift and error rate recovery within minutes during a prior degradation. Current severe p99 write latency (5x target for 90 minutes) at peak settlement traffic requires immediate broad action. Compliance blocks rollback of the security-patched release. Regional failover shifts all traffic including writes to another region while preserving customer writes, directly addressing the primary objective. Route_read_replicas (memory_b5) helped write latency before by offloading reads, but regional failover offers faster, more comprehensive recovery for the current severity and proven clean execution.
